vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 03-storyboard-prompter
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a straightforward utility for generating AI image prompts from script data. The code in skill.js performs simple string concatenation to create prompts and lacks any network access, file system operations, or suspicious logic. All files, including SKILL.md and manifest.json, are consistent with the stated purpose of local storyboard prompt generation.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are consistent with its stated purpose: it locally transforms scene objects into positive/negative AI-art prompts and does not request extra privileges or network access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (generate consistent positive/negative AI art prompts locally) match the actual implementation: no external APIs, no extra binaries or environment variables are requested, and the code produces prompts from input scenes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the code align: both describe local prompt generation. Minor implementation note: the code expects each scene object to have properties like scene, character, and action; if those fields are missing the output may contain the string 'undefined'. There are no instructions to read files, call networks, or access unrelated system state.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only plus a tiny local JS file). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer; risk is low.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Its behavior (string composition) does not require any secrets or elevated access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request persistent privileges or modify other skills/settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but is not combined with any other high-risk capability here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe and does exactly what it claims: locally build positive/negative prompts from scene objects. Before using it, ensure the scenes you pass are structured as expected (each item should include scene, character, action) to avoid 'undefined' tokens. Also avoid feeding sensitive or private data into prompt fields you don't want embedded in generated prompts. If you need validation or richer formatting, review or extend the small skill.js file—its logic is short and readable.
